description: A sliced FP16 Linear requests padding to slice dimensions before the full checkpoint tensor is sliced.
trigger: Load an unquantized model with GatedMLP intermediate_size greater than MAX_MLP_INTERMEDIATE (55296), requiring true slices.
expected_behavior: Load the full tensor and slice it before padding to slice dimensions.
actual_behavior: The eager loader allocates slice-sized padding and attempts to copy the full checkpoint tensor into a smaller view, causing a shape mismatch before LinearFP16 slicing.

introductions.rationale: Fable identifies this regression in the task changes moving transformations into get_tensor; no execution.

observations.description: A sliced FP16 Linear requests padding to slice dimensions before the full checkpoint tensor is sliced.

Issue 38 identifies a DeciLMForCausalLM checkpoint with an eight-way sliced MLP (49,920 versus 399,360), corroborating this padding mismatch itself. The reporter runtime revision is not independently pinned. No local model execution or continuous affected range established.

fixes.rationale: Both weight and optional bias use pad_to=None for sliced FP16 loads, preserving the full checkpoint tensor for existing CPU slicing. Unsliced padding is retained.
